system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: We provide the following input format to the Agent, consisting of the system prompt, execution history, the current observation as a DOM representation, and the user query containing the goal.
system_prompt_style.note: The paper does not say how the system prompt is built. The linked repo vostride/agent-qa is an unrelated QA-testing product, not MultiOn's Agent Q, so it was not used for any cell.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Subsequent observations consist of web pages from the browser, represented as a HTML DOM format.
env_context_strategy.note: Web agent. The current page DOM is injected each step and the agent navigates with browser actions.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: That is, the agent history consists of the actions generated so far and the current browser state.
context_compaction.note: Past DOM observations are dropped; only the current one is kept.

observation_format.evidence_quote: we design an intermediate state representation that crawls the raw HTML content of a website to retrieve relevant visual components, and highlight interactive elements to the model.
observation_format.note: The observation is a DOM text representation. GPT-4-V screenshots are used only by the evaluator.

tool_call_format.note: The actions are text commands such as CLICK [ID]. The parsing mechanism is not described.

tool_count.evidence_quote: The agent is allowed the actions, "CLICK [ID]", "GOTO [URL]", "TYPE [ID] [TEXT]", "SUBMIT [ID]", "CLEAR [ID]", "SCROLL [UP/DOWN]", and "ASK USER HELP".
tool_count.note: This is the OpenTable action set. WebShop used a different set.

self_verification.evidence_quote: At the end of a trajectory, a GPT-4-V evaluator is called to provide feedback on the agent’s performance given the final observation and action history to determine the success score.
self_verification.note: The self-critique is the same base model ranking proposed actions (Sec. 5.1.1).

retry_policy.note: MCTS rollouts are search, not task-level retries.
